title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — October 22, 2026

NOAA Active Region 4560 stands out on the visible solar disk today as an unusually spot-rich active region.

📍 Location: N13W42
☀️ Region: AR 4560
🔥 Recent activity: 2 C-class flares

Somebody brought freckles to work.

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Images: NASA SDO/HMI — Continuum Intensity, Intensitygram (Flattened), Intensitygram
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
